आदेि , 2020 ंें संियोगधन करने के जलए जनम्न जलजखत आदेि करती है, नांत :- 1. संजिप्त िीर्धक रर प्र ारंभ – (1) इस आदेि कयोग सेफ्टी ग् ला स (गवणवत्ता जनयं्ण) संियोगधन आदेि , 2020 कहा िाएगा। (2) यह इसके िासकीय रािप् ंें प्र कािन की तारीख से प्र भावी हयोगगा। 2. सेफ्टी ग् ला स (गवणवत्ता जनयं्ण) आदेि , 2020 ंें पैराग्राफ 1 ंें उप -पैराग्राफ ( 2) कयोग जनम्न जलजखत उप-पैराग्राफ से प्र जतस्ट्था जपत दकया िाएगा, नांत: “(2) यह 1 अप्रैल , 2021 से लागू हयोगगा।” [फा. सं. 11(6)/2017-सीआई] अजनल अग्रवाल , संयवक्त सजवव सं. 1793] नई ददल्ली , ंं गल वार, िून 23, 2020/आर्ाढ़ 2, 1942 No. 1793] NEW DELHI, TUESDAY, JUNE 23, 2020/ASHADHA 2, 1942 सी.जी.-डी.एल.-अ.-23062020-220116 CG-DL-E-23062020-220116 -- 1 of 2 -- 2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] नयोगट : प्रं व ख आदेि का.आ. 1045 (अ), ददनांक 12 ं ावध , 2020 के िररए भारत के रािप् , असाधारण, भाग -II, खंड 3, उप-खंड (ii) के तहत प्र काजित ु आ था। MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) ORDER New Delhi, the 23rd June, 2020 S.O. 2018(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 16 read with sub-section (3) of section 25 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016 (11 of 2016), the Central Government, after consulting the Bureau of Indian Standards, is of the opinion that it is necessary so to do in the public interest, hereby makes the following Order to amend the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020, namely:- 1. Short title and commencement.– (1) This Order may be called the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Amendment Order, 2020. (2) It shall come into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette. 2. In the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020, in Paragraph 1, for sub-Paragraph (2), the following sub- Paragraph shall be substituted, namely “ (2) It shall come into force with effect from 1st April, 2021.” [F. No. 11(6)/2017-CI] ANIL AGRAWAL, Jt. Secy. Note : The principal Order was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) vide number S.O.1045(E), dated the 12th March, 2020..
